title: A Closed-Form Solution for Debiasing Vision-Language Models with Utility Guarantees Across Modalities and Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated across multiple vision-language tasks by calculating Equal Opportunity (EO) violation in zero-shot image classification, MaxSkew@M in text-to-image retrieval, and Statistical Parity (SP) of perceived gender in text-to-image generation using neutral occupational prompts.
Evaluated intersectionally with gender by measuring Equal Opportunity (EO) violation in zero-shot image classification using the CelebA dataset (e.g., Male-Old vs. Female-Young).
Evaluated intersectionally with gender by calculating the MaxSkew@M metric in text-to-image retrieval using the COCO2017 dataset (e.g., Light-skinned Female vs. Dark-skinned Male).
